title: Up/Down Counter
statement: Implement an up/down counter that increments or decrements a 4-bit value based on a direction input. On each clock edge it should count up when direction is 1 and down when direction is 0. A synchronous reset must set the counter to zero.
module_signature: module up_down_counter(input clk, input rst, input dir, output reg [3:0] count);
behavior: If dir is 1, count increments on each clock edge.
If dir is 0, count decrements on each clock edge.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous operations or parallel load features.
hint: Implement count with straightforward increment/decrement logic and a reset branch.
